shadcn.note: Design system: see DESIGN.md. Style through component variants/sizes and theme tokens, not className overrides.

message.spacing: {{component}} owns its spacing. Use a size ({{sizes|none defined}}) or gap on the parent. See DESIGN.md.
message.default: Don't restyle {{component}} with className. Use a variant ({{variants|none defined}}), or add a variant to components/ui. See DESIGN.md.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Use a theme color token ({{tokens|none defined}}) instead of {{className}}. See DESIGN.md.

shadcn/no-inline-styles.message: No inline styles in app code. Data-driven colors go through <Swatch>, <Progress indicatorColor> or chart fills (ChartConfig, <Cell fill>). See DESIGN.md.
